title: Deactivate Account shows no Turn Off Technician warning and keeps work
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, so the list has a technician to compare with.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in In Progress, led by staff member A.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Click Deactivate Account for staff member A.
  2. Open work order 1.
  3. Open the Lead Technician dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • No "Turn Off Technician" warning shows.
  • Staff member A moves to the Deactivated tab.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1 still shows staff member A as its lead.

Step 3:

  • Staff member A is listed last, grayed out, with the check mark, and cannot be picked.
  • Staff member B is offered and can be picked.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member), story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S1-E4: “Deactivate Account shows no Turn Off Technician warning. The person keeps their Technician toggle as it was (S1-E2), is not offered as a technician while deactivated, and keeps every work order and line they hold.”
  • S1-E2: “A deactivated staff member keeps their Technician toggle as it was, but is not a technician while deactivated (Story 3). Reactivating them brings it back as it was.”
  • S3-R7: “A work order's current lead who is not offered per S3-R1 still shows as the lead on the work order and in Board View and Tech View. In the Lead Technician dropdown they are listed last, grayed out, with the check mark, and cannot be picked. Picking someone else saves at once, as today, and the former lead then leaves the dropdown.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
